source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Sir / Madam,

We are writing to formally request access to inspect the archived first
registration application files relating to:

WA231076
WA240304

This request concerns the full first registration case files, including all
supporting documentation, correspondence, internal notes, and any
associated index map search material.

I am specifically requesting permission to:
Inspect the physical archived files (or digital scans if the originals are
not accessible)
Review all documents submitted in support of the applications

Review any examiner notes, requisitions, or internal annotations made
during processing

Identify any records of third-party claims, disputes, objections, or
references to adverse occupation or competing claims
Confirm whether any such material was present on the file at the time of
registration
If the files are no longer held in physical form, please confirm:

the date and manner of destruction (if applicable), or

whether they have been digitised or transferred to another archive location
If inspection is not possible, I would be grateful if you could instead
provide certified copies of the complete file contents.

Please also confirm the procedure for arranging an appointment for
inspection, including any identification or fees required.

Regards,

Requester and heirs of Mary Williams of Great House Farm, Llandough C/O
[address redacted] [postcode redacted], United Kingdom
